# Report privately

**Do not include vulnerability details in a public issue.** Read
[SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for the proposed reporting channels and their
verification status before sending sensitive information.

Mailbox delivery and GitHub private reporting are unverified in this local
foundation. The response times in the security policy are targets, not proof
that a report will be received or acknowledged.
